# MD Faysal Hossain

> MD Faysal Hossain is a certified MERN Stack Developer, web designer, SEO expert and NSDA-certified trainer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He builds React.js / Node.js / MongoDB applications, eCommerce and CMS websites, and teaches web design and freelancing skills. Available for remote projects in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and Europe.

Key facts: name "MD Faysal Hossain" (also "FaysalByte"); location Dhaka, Bangladesh; languages: English, Bengali; contact via the website form, email or WhatsApp.

- [Home](https://faysalbyte.github.io/): Overview, roles and certifications

## Services

- MERN stack development (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js)
- Web design and responsive front-end development
- eCommerce and CMS development (Shopify, WordPress, Wix, Webflow, Squarespace)
- SEO and digital marketing
- Android app development with Kotlin
- Web design and freelancing training (NSDA certified trainer)

## Certifications

- NSDA Level-3 and Level-5 Web Design and Web Development for Freelancing
- NSDA Level-4 Android App Development with Kotlin
- NSDA Level-4 Web Application Development with Python
- NSDA Level-3 and Level-4 Digital Marketing for Freelancing (SEO)
- NSDA Level-3 Software Quality Assurance
- Industrial MERN Stack Certification (Daffodil International Professional Training Institute)
